description: RFC 0009 extends the single creative gate with package fidelity, first-30-second fidelity, and an explicit abandon recommendation so a weak idea can die before asset spend instead of being forced through after retries.

first_30_fidelity.description: Does 0-30s deliver and intensify the pre-click promise without neutral setup?

package_fidelity.description: Does the script honestly deliver the selected title/thumbnail/curiosity proposition rather than drifting into another video?

abandon_recommended.description: True when the premise/package itself appears unable to clear the bar with a normal rewrite, rather than the current draft merely needing execution fixes.

abandon_reason.description: Required as an empty string when false; concrete structural reason when true.
